goal: Iteratively raise WPT scores across dom/events, dom/nodes, css/selectors, css/css-flexbox, css-box toward 100% via spec-driven (WHATWG/W3C/ECMAScript) fixes, not test-specific hacks.
constraints: No WPT-specific hacks; all fixes must cite and comply with the relevant spec section.
zig build test must stay green after every commit.
Parallel work only on fully file-disjoint tasks (prior chaos bite).
Commit small and frequent; push in batches.

stories.title: Baseline + root-cause classification (all 5 areas)
acceptanceCriteria: Fresh WPT baseline logs exist at /tmp/wpt-flexbox-baseline.log, /tmp/wpt-dom-events-baseline.log, /tmp/wpt-dom-nodes-baseline.log, /tmp/wpt-selectors-baseline.log.
For each area, a written cluster breakdown of failures with spec citations is produced in the session.
Top 3 highest-impact fixes per area are identified with files + approach + estimated test gain.
memory/project_suzume_wpt_progress.md is refreshed with the new baselines.

stories.title: css/css-flexbox: implement top-impact spec fix cluster #1
acceptanceCriteria: Highest-impact flexbox fix (e.g. getComputedStyle initial resolution for flex-* shorthands per CSS Flexbox L1 §7 + CSSOM §6.5) is implemented.
Fix cites the CSS spec section in a code comment only if the why is non-obvious.
WPT css/css-flexbox score improves by ≥ 5 percentage points vs. baseline.
zig build test passes.
Change is committed with a spec-referencing message.

stories.title: css/css-flexbox: implement top-impact fix cluster #2
acceptanceCriteria: Second flexbox fix (likely flex-basis intrinsic sizing or flex-wrap column) implemented per CSS Flexbox L1.
WPT css/css-flexbox score gains another ≥ 3 percentage points.
zig build test green; commit made.

stories.title: dom/events: close remaining spec-compliant gaps
acceptanceCriteria: After re-baseline post-Shadow-DOM-Phase-1/2 merge, remaining failures are bucketed.
Any cluster not blocked on navigation/testdriver/cross-realm is fixed (≥ 1 cluster).
WPT dom/events score reaches ≥ 93% (from 89.9%).
zig build test green; commits made.

stories.title: dom/nodes + css/selectors: close residual spec gaps
acceptanceCriteria: At least 2 cluster fixes across the two areas, one per area.
dom/nodes reaches ≥ 94%; css/selectors reaches ≥ 88%.
All fixes cite DOM Living Standard or Selectors L4 sections.
zig build test green; commits made.

stories.title: Shadow DOM Phase 3 kickoff: slots assignment algorithm
acceptanceCriteria: HTMLSlotElement class + named/default slot assignment per DOM §4.2.2.3 implemented.
assignedNodes / assignedElements / assign() available on slot element.
slotchange event fires on assignment change.
Unit tests cover named slot, default slot, reassignment, slotchange firing.
zig build test green; commit made.

stories.title: Shadow DOM Phase 3: flattened tree view for layout + :host matcher
acceptanceCriteria: Flattened tree iterator consumed by layout per DOM §4.2.2.4.
:host selector matcher integrated; matches only within that shadow scope.
Scoped stylesheet list on ShadowRoot honored by selector engine.
WPT shadow-dom slots tests show measurable pass improvement.
zig build test green; commit made.

stories.title: Verification pass + memory + push
acceptanceCriteria: All updated areas re-baselined; scores recorded in memory/project_suzume_wpt_progress.md with timestamps.
Commits pushed to origin/main.
Reviewer (architect) signs off on spec-compliance of changes.
ai-slop-cleaner run on changed files; post-cleanup zig build test passes.
